notes.title: Update#1.7 Announcement
notes.content:
Hi, Warriors! This time, we are bringing a new version which the battle rhythm has been greatly improved to you! Attack speed is faster! The damage is higher! We benefits the players with giving you a bigger chance to beat three players by themselves! Also, there is new game mode, 3v3 capture battle, come and carry your teammates!

[h2]Key improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Improved the combat system, the team organization system and the rhythm of the game. 
[*] Redesigned the drop system of classic mode. Equips used to drop in random spots, now is changed to drop at the specific spots. 
[*] A new game mode of 3v3.
[/list]


[h2]Combat system adjustments[/h2]
[list]
[*] Greatly improved the rhythm of the combat.
[list]
[*] Improved the attack speed of most weapons, greatly improved the damage of the main weapons.
[*] Decreased the attack times of the light weapons and standard weapons’ combo, but the total damage of the combo doesn’t change.
[*] Slightly increased the speed and distance of the rolling.
[/list]
[*] Weakened the attack method beyond the main weapon.
[list]
[*] Greatly increased the CD of the spells and sub weapons.
[*] The trajectory of bow and crossbow has been modified to be a straight line instead of a parabola.
[/list]
[*] Added some new combat mechanics:
[list]
[*] After the main weapon hitting the enemy, it will return 50% of the stamina consumed by this attack.
[*] After expelling the enemy, you will get a buff which helps your recovering.
[*] After hitting down the enemy, you will get a buff only last for 8 seconds, and helps you to immediately relieve the state of being unable to sprint.
[/list]
[*] About team organizing system:
[list]
[*] Unless you are using the main weapon, you won’t be blocked by your teammates.
[*] Added a new magic weapon. [Serpent Staff]. This is a long-range weapon which is better used in the team combat, but the shoot distance is not very long, also limited with CD, and it cannot trigger the hit effect.
[/list]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32331996/3431c463711655c585e080cd9842631dfe320a95.gif[/img]

[h2]Redesigned the drop system of classic mode[/h2]

In the past versions, the treasure chest and barrels are set at random places, and the probability of falling in each area is uniform. So there is no differences of each areas. Now, we have some new changes:
[list]
[*] The treasure chest is classified into 4 qualities (white, blue, purple, golden), the number and spot are settled. The equips in golden chest is stationary.
[*] The equips are never dropped from the barrels, instead of showing on the random spots.
[*] The spots of the treasure chests are showed on the map, you can mark it.
[/list]

[h2]Capture mode (Competitive mode)[/h2]

[list]
[*] Players: 3v3
[*] Rules: Capture the gate! The team whose total control time reaches 100 seconds scores first and opens the next round.
[*] The winning rule: 2 out of 3 games.
[/list]

[h2]Misc[/h2]

[list]
[*] Adjusted the map [Ancient maze], It is mainly due to the significant reduction of the upper left and upper right forest areas.
[*] Redesigned the effects of the armor repair and some buffs.
[*] Improved some UI issues (Shop, Cardpack, Items picking, Combat results, Spectator system)
[*] Added the UI of knocking down the enemy which are showed by achievement sign.
[*] Improved the intelligent level of the navigation line.
[/list]

1.7 update will be online this weekend.
Thank you for supporting us.
Have fun in the dungeon!
Soulfire Team
2020/7/9

notes.title: Update #1.6 Announcement
notes.content:
Hello Warriors! 

From this update, we will try to add some fast-paced, battle-based, less player requested gameplay, and the “free combat” is our first try.

[h2]Major update[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added free combat gameplay, 6 players per match, unlimited revival.
[*] Added compete mode and revival mode. Players can set up the combat equips in the compete mode.
[*] Adjusted the operations of rushing and rolling, removed the magic value. Removed abilities of some combat skills to pass through the enemy.
[*] Updated the animation of being attacked, it has been refined from the previous one into many. The animations attacked by the enemy from up, down, left and right are different now, which are same in the previous version.
[/list]

[h2]Free combat gameplay
[/h2]
[list]
[*] Players scale: 6 players (solo)
[*] Map: Silent Cemetery
[*] Scoring rule: Players can get 1 point through knocking down one other player. Assists cannot be scored, and players need get the final attack to get scores.
[*] Revival rule: If you are knocked down, you will respawn at random locations. In this mode, each respawn will randomly change equips without re-pickup.
[*] Winning rule: The player who reach 20 points wins; if no players reaches this goal at the end of the time, the players with the most points wins.
[/list]

[h2]Compete mode and Revival mode
[/h2]
[list]
[*] In compete mode, players can freely configure equips and wear them every time they respawn. All equips will occupy the equips points, so that it is difficult for players to match a very perfect character, and some trade-offs need to be made. Some collocations tend to be survivable, some collocations tend to be offensive, and some are good at poking.
[*] Other gameplay that do not require pre-installation will be classified in the revival mode.
[/list]

[h2]Combat system adjustment
[/h2]
[list]
[*] The rushing operation is changed from long-pressing the space bar to quickly clicking twice on the arrow keys. This is a common design used in arcade games. This change can make some attack requires rushing much easier to launch, and we will decide whether to increase the limit to sprint attack after a period of time.
[*] The rolling operation is triggered from the previous press of the space, and it is modified to trigger immediately when it is pressed. This will make the rolling operation more immediate.
[*] Removed the magic value, and related items. Now the spell using is only limited by the cool down time.
[*] Removed the pass through function of dagger’s combat skill, katana’s combat skill and pyrodance, as they caused some jitter bugs and could not be resolved for a long time.
[/list]


Have fun in dungeon!
Soulfire team
2020/3/24

notes.title: Soulfire major update! New mode, new weapons!
notes.content:
The solo mode of Soulfire has finally arrived, and there is no longer any need to worry about matching the unreliable teammates, who always prevent me from victory! I heard that the new version also added some powerful weapons, so I interviewed the producer of Soulfire, PixelBacterium (PB for short), to understand the latest information.



I: Hello PB, I heard that the latest version of Soulfire has added a very powerful primary weapon - whip sword. What is its design inspiration?

PB: Whip sword is a relatively common type of weapon in ACG. There are characters in SoulCalibur to use this weapon, and in Bloodborne. In short, it is a weapon with two forms, sword and whip. There are also many cases in comic, such as Tenjō Tenge and Bleach. There are also chain sword in Pacific Rim, but mainly in the form of sword. Of course, there is no such thing in reality, because with such a structure, it is difficult to guarantee the performance of the sword form. However, it looks cool. We also have other deformable weapons under development.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32331996/b8fe604bb2c93f581a9e96a4e43d535070b3356d.gif[/img]


I: It seems to be very powerful. Will the addition of the whip sword destroy the game balance?

PB: The whip sword is found in the treasure chest of the fourth treasure thief only. There is only one whip sword in one match. Its strength is definitely more than other weapons. However, this strength is not numerically, but the versatility of the action module. Its general attack is the speed of standard weapons, and the combat skill has the range of heavy weapons. The advantages of both weapons are taken into account, and there are no shortcomings. If you do want to ask for its shortcomings, it is that its impact level and hyper-armor level are only equivalent to tier 2 weapons. While to be honest, the disadvantages in actual combat are negligible.



I: The new secondary weapon, poison gas bottle, when should I use it?

PB: The positioning of the poison gas bottle is a group battle weapon that can force the enemies to move in one position. It is not suitable for solo match, but it can be used in place such as edge of the dreamland gate. However, the damage of the poison gas bottle is not high at present, which may need some enhancement.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32331996/cd65edf2ac91a271f2a7327806e2d5f08c637191.gif[/img]


I: Final question. The price of Soulfire has reduced from $16.99 to $6.99. What is the consideration?

PB: In fact, we also launched a free version, which has essentially the same functionality as the paid version, except that you cannot buy items with gold. This is all about making more players enjoy Soulfire.


I: Great, I cannot wait to try out the new weapons, see you in the dungeon!
PB: See you in the dungeon!

notes.title: #1.1 Update – Patch Notes Now Live
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32331996/eed93a9aa3a8ad78544fbc4a7d42524dfcd5a4fd.jpg[/img]
Hi everyone!
Patch update #1.1 is here, and it is packed full of new features, balance and gameplay adjustments, and fixes! An observer module has been added into the game which will allow for tournaments in the future, and a free version will be included with this update that we trust will bring many more players to the dungeon.

[h1][b]Added Observer feature[/b][/h1]

1. In custom match, the match owner can set any player as the observers. The observers’ names will be displayed on the right side of the screen.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32331996/29bfda8ee5a473ea58fdbe3f798455fed2157933.png[/img]

2. The observer can see every player team number, player name, and player HP and armor on the full map. Double-clicking will allow the observer to switch between viewed players.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32331996/d868a823a199b550c08ba2ca1b23dfe2f9e9a529.png[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32331996/25b1935c7eee18027b8b21c7946c3f32ee171439.png[/img]

3. We have made big improvements in the player’s spectate experience.
Note: Players can check the spectated player’s equipment by pressing [ Tab ].

4. Added in-game ranking list, which can be checked by pressing [ B ].

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32331996/8b67bd6e826d0cfc817313a2106c23bb364da156.png[/img]

[h1][b]Balance Improvments[/b][/h1]

1. Reduced the projectile speed and increased the cooldowns of most long-range attacks, especially the Fukiya.
2. Attacks made with a main weapon can no longer be interrupted by the Fukiya, Shortbow, Longbow, Light Crossbow, Repeater Crossbow, Hook, or Fireball.
3. The damage of Harquebus and Hurricane Smash have been significantly decreased. The efficiency and power of these group injury + knockdown skills in group battles were much too high.
4. The first few attack stages of the Shortbow and the Longbow were weakened.
5. Increased the lunge distance of the Pike’s and the Great Sword’s heavy attack. Optimized the attack curve of the first heavy attack of the Poleaxe to make it hit enemies from further away.
6. Twin Axes have been lowered in tier from 3 stars to 2 stars.
7. Reduced the drop rate of Twinblades, and increased the drop rates of Iron Skin, Great Hammer, Great Scythe, Pike, and Great Sword.
8. Increased the rolling speed of all weapons. Reduced the rolling distance penalty while holding heavy weapons, increasing the survival odds of heavy weapon wielders after being knocked down by others.
9. The third stage of Pyrodance will move the caster through teammates, which will enhance its role in team combat.
10. Slightly reduced the Drenched and Burn debuffs. Significantly decreased the duration of the Gust buff.
11. Reduced the duration of Escapology, and the player can no longer cancel the spell effect prematurely. Reduced the movement speed increase gained from enhancing Escapology with Doppelganger Skin.
12. Taunting action can now be canceled by rolling.
13. Reduced the difficulty of performing a parry with the blunderbuss.

[b]Developer notes[/b]: The main direction of these balance changes is to weaken long-range attacks. On the one hand, it is guaranteed that some long-range attacks can be more easily evaded (especially the Fukiya). On the other hand, it reduces the effect of long-range weapons and spells in team fights. In the previous team fights, there were too many long-range attack interruptions, making it difficult for players to perform melee attacks. Additionally, the damage output of long-range attacks was too high.


[h1][b]Match pacing[/b][/h1]

1. Increased the time required to clear the Dreamland Gate.
2. Increased the maximum range of the safe zone surrounding the Dreamland Gate and decreased the rate in which the progress meter empties when the team leaves the safe zone, or it becomes contested.
3. Significantly increased the Mist damage during the final stage.

[b]Developer notes[/b]: Players can't hide in the Mist and rely on healing items as a stall tactic anymore. With the increased Mist damage, it's much more difficult for players to win the game without competing with other players.


[h1][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h1]

1. Fixed an issue where the zone events did not occur.
2. Fixed an issue where enemy players’ voices could still be heard even when the sound setting was toggled to Team Only.
3. Fixed an issue that prevented backstabbing an enemy who recently recovered from a knockdown.
4. Fixed an issue where the Hook could hit additional enemies on its return.
5. Fixed an issue where the male character using a Great Stick’s heavy attack would have a shortened hyper-armor duration.
6. Fixed an issue of attacks sometimes missing with some weapons.
7. Fixed an issue where players could be bounced in the air when they were attacked by Airblast, Hurricane Smash, and some weapons.
8. Fixed an issue where Hurricane Smash collision distance could be too short, causing it to stop suddenly in front of an enemy.
9. Fixed an issue where the Katana’s hits may not have registered if certain skins were equipped.
10. Fixed an issue where players may not return at full of health when reviving in the beginner tutorial.
11. Fixed an issue that could cause a team invitation to appear when opening card packs.


[h1][b]Ranking point rule changes[/b][/h1]

1. Ranking points will not increase or decrease after you play in a Custom Match.
2. Previously, killing an enemy who was more than 1,000 points lower than the player resulted in no points being awarded. We have removed this rule so that every enemy you kill will now earn you points.
3. After reaching Gold rank, AI opponents you kill will no longer award points.
4. The number of kills will now also account for enemies you’ve knocked down and who either chose to release, were finished off by other players, or who were knocked down by you and in a downed state when their last teammate died.


[h1][b]UI improvement[/b][/h1]

1. You can now view other pages while you are queued.
2. The tutorial can now be skipped.
3. The current server and network speed can now be seen on the main menu.


[h1][b]Free version[/b][/h1]

  Alongside the 1.1 update, we are releasing a free version for players to try. The differences between the free version and the full version are that in the free version players cannot use their gold to purchase card packs or skins from the gold store, and free version players can earn points but cannot be ranked. Player data from the free version carries over to the full version; after purchasing the full version, all the items obtained in the free version will be retained, and the player will become ranked with their position on the leaderboard to qualify for end-of-season rewards.


[i]Last but not least, the top ten players in the rankings before the ranks reset. The development of Soulfire can not be achieved without your support![/i]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32331996/7ed69f1c9a3dc4423be9d7634f787d20adfd27ce.jpg[/img]


Have fun in dungeon!
2019/7/31
Soulfire Team

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32331996/2d1c902fb3eae2ac9a534e14419edf8860353544.jpg[/img]

【活动概述】
首届“魂火杯”魂火争霸赛将于七月拉开帷幕，优胜者将会获得巨额现金奖励！只要入围最终决赛均可获得现金奖励。快快拉上你的小伙伴，让我们一起《灵魂之火》吧！

【报名时间】
[b]2019年7月8日12:00至2019年7月31日24:00[/b]
8月1日公布海选名单、分组与赛程，届时官方Q群、贴吧、微博会第一时间同步更新。

【报名方式】
在贴吧按照格式回复后，加群找管理员“活动报名管理”提供对应信息。
贴吧链接：https://tieba.baidu.com/p/6188702777

【奖金设置】
[b]决赛第一名队伍：9000元人民币现金
决赛第二名队伍：6000元人民币现金
决赛第三名队伍：3000元人民币现金
决赛入围队伍：300元人民币现金[/b]
海选赛入围玩家：10个皮肤卡包/人
精英赛入围玩家：20个皮肤卡包/人
现金奖励将于比赛正式结束后于7个工作日之内发放完毕。
卡包奖励将于比赛正式开始之前发放完毕。

【赛事安排】
海选赛阶段：8.2~8.
精英赛阶段：8.3~8.8
决赛阶段：8.9-8.10
以上安排仅供参考，具体赛程会根据报名人数动态调整。

【活动内容】
整个活动分为四个阶段：报名阶段-海选赛阶段-精英赛阶段-决赛阶段
玩家以“三人一组”的形式进行报名，队伍中必须有一人要达到白银段位，否则报名无效。报名活动结束后，根据报名玩家数量分组，进行海选赛。根据每场比赛的排名和淘汰人数，计算出每个队伍的积分，最终决定入围精英赛人员的资格。同样根据积分赛制，从精英赛中决出最终决赛的资格，之后通过决赛决出最后的赢家。

【注意事项】
1、参与比赛需要《灵魂之火》正式版游戏资格。获取途径有：购买游戏（游戏上线后）、不删档公测期间的冲榜活动。
2、海选阶段最多录用120队，如果超出则按照队伍的总战力值进行排序筛选。
3、为了方便管理通知，所有报名队伍（无论是否入围）均需加入官方Q群，之后的安排会在该群内逐个通知队长，[b]如未能联系到则算作弃权。[/b]
4、动期间禁止使用任何第三方软件（包括但不限于外挂等）以及代练操作比赛，一经违反，取消所有奖励、参赛资格。
5、本活动最终解释权归《灵魂之火》官方所有。

【关于我们】
官方QQ群：569576788
官方贴吧：灵魂之火吧
官方微博：@灵魂之火Soulfire

《灵魂之火》制作组
7月18日

你们好！

首先请注意：[b]1） 本次Beta测试将会延期至北美时间7月5日，延长一周时间。

切换服务器操作如下图所示：

notes.title: Soulfire Beta Test Period Extended Announcement
notes.content:
Dear Warriors: 

First of all, please notice that [b]1). the period of Soulfire Beta Test will open up to an extra week,  extending to July 5th ;
2). European Server and Eastern US Server are available this time. [/b]

The images showed how to change servers below: 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32331996/b63cf8296aceb4df09833f7c8d635e609fbba58c.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32331996/7af2d156cc56f96cb953d38f70674654e0511ee8.png[/img]

Last week the first beta test of Soulfire opened on steam, and as dev team we received various feedback from players in different countries. It is really an opportunity to conduct thorough testing that ensures there won’t be any issue before EA release, while being mindful about the player experience from both a technical and social perspective. 

So we decided to extend the beta period under strong demands. In order to reduce lag, we add two more servers at this time - European Server and Eastern US Server. We hope to try our best to promote our game and can bring players a wonderful game experience.

Thanks so much for anyone who attended the beta test this time, and welcome new to join in us! 

Soulfire Dev Team
25/06/2019

notes.title: Soulfire Open Beta Test Announcement
notes.content:
[h1] Soulfire Beta Test Announcement	[/h1]

Brave Warriors:
Greetings.

First of all, please notice that the test period of Soulfire is [b]Jun 20th 21:00pm - Jun 27th 21:00pm[/b] EST.

Pleased to make your acquaintance, allow me to introduce our game, Soulfire.

Soulfire is a battle royale fighter that pits more than 20 teams against each other in a struggle for win.Compared to similar games, it features a 2.5D souls-lite combat system.

We hope that Soulfire can bring you a new way of enjoying gaming, and will also introduce the charm of Souls-lite Battle Royale competition. As the game is still being developed intensely, so the test will not present the final quality of the game. Your valuable opinions and suggestions will be the driving force for the continuous improvement of Soulfire, as well as your enthusiasm and passion will be our motivation. 

Finally, we would like to express our gratitude to you for participating in this test and supporting our game. Thank you!
